Frozen PR3 v1 contract, 2026-11-13, supplied by the PR3 implementing agent.
The location/timezone groups were emitted by production cli_identity.c in its
host harness, implemented in PR3 commit 0e82423 (PR #100). Stable legacy identity fields are added by each test's USB peer.
These are host-harness captures, not physical-board qualification. The next
coordinated PR3 bench slot must confirm them against the real firmware image.
Capability token: timezone.auto. Without it, all timezone maintenance is display-only.

Frozen cfg output:
  cfg get timezone -> timezone = Europe/Berlin
  cfg set timezone Asia/Tokyo -> cfg set timezone = Asia/Tokyo  (reboot to apply)
  cfg set timezone auto -> cfg set timezone = auto  (reboot to apply)
  cfg get timezone -> timezone = Europe/Berlin (unchanged after auto)
  cfg get timezone_source -> timezone_source = auto
The explicit setter changes only the fallback and preserves the pin/source key.
The auto setter releases a pin; fallback maintenance must never invoke it.
